title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON ESTABLISHMENT OF NATIONAL UNIVERSITY DENTAL HOSPITALS

ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON ESTABLISHMENT OF NATIONAL UNIVERSITY DENTAL HOSPITALS

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Establishment of National University Dental Hospitals and matters necessary for its enforcement.

Article 2 (Registration of Incorporation, etc.)
(1) The registration of incorporation of a national university dental hospital (hereinafter referred to as a "university dental hospital") under Article 2 of the Act on Establishment of National University Dental Hospitals (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") shall be completed within three weeks from the date on which authorization of its articles of incorporation is granted.
(2) Matters to be registered upon incorporation under paragraph (1) shall be as follows:
1. Purpose;
2. Name;
3. Location of the principal office;
4. Names and addresses of officers;
5. Matters concerning the authority of representation;
6. Method of public announcement.
(3) Where any matter specified in the subparagraphs of paragraph (2) changes, a university dental hospital shall register the change within three weeks from the date of its occurrence.

Article 3 (Documents to Be Attached to Applications for Registration)
An application for registration under Article 2 (1) or (3) shall be accompanied by the relevant documents as classified in the following subparagraphs:
1. For registration of incorporation under Article 2 (1): The articles of incorporation of the relevant university dental hospital;
2. For registration of a change under Article 2 (3): Documents proving the relevant change.

Article 4 (Subordinate Organizations)
(1) A university dental hospital shall have a Clinical Services Department, an Administration Division, a Planning and Coordination Office, and an Education and Research Office under the hospital director under Article 12 (1) of the Act; they may be operated in an integrated manner as prescribed by its articles of incorporation. <Amended on August 9, 2022>
(2) The Clinical Services Department and the Administration Division shall each have one head, and the Planning and Coordination Office and the Education and Research Office shall each have one head; depending on the circumstances of the university dental hospital, these positions may be held concurrently. <Amended on August 9, 2022>
(3) Matters concerning the allocation of duties among the department, division, and offices under paragraph (1), and the composition and allocation of duties of their subordinate organizations, shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation. <Amended on August 9, 2022>

Article 5 (Requirements for Directors Other than Ex Officio Directors)
"Requirements prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 9 (2) of the Act means having either of the following types of experience: <Amended on May 7, 2019>
1. At least three years of experience managing a hospital-level medical institution falling under Article 3 (2) 3 (b) or (e) of the Medical Service Act (hereinafter referred to as "general hospitals, etc.");
2. At least 10 years of experience performing clinical or administrative duties at general hospitals, etc.

Article 6 (Duties of the Auditor)
(1) The duties of the auditor shall be as follows:
1. Auditing the status of the property of the university dental hospital;
2. Auditing accounts and related affairs;
3. Auditing other matters prescribed by the articles of incorporation.
(2) Where the auditor discovers any irregularity or deficiency as a result of an audit, the auditor shall report such fact to the board of directors and the Minister of Education without delay. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(3) Matters concerning the methods and procedures for the performance of the auditor's duties, etc. shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation.

Article 7 (Operation of the Board of Directors)
(1) Where a director (excluding the chairperson) is unable to attend a meeting for a special reason, the director may designate a proxy (a proxy for an ex officio director under Article 9 (2) of the Act shall be designated from among public officials under the director's authority) to attend the meeting. In such cases, the proxy's voting rights shall be recognized only with respect to agenda items of which advance notice was given when the board meeting was convened. <Amended on May 7, 2019>
(2) The board of directors shall have executive secretaries and clerks, and matters concerning their number and appointment shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation.

Article 8 (Recommendation of the Director of a University Dental Hospital)
(1) "A person who meets the qualifications prescribed by Presidential Decree" in the latter part of Article 12 (3) of the Act means a person falling under either of the following subparagraphs: <Amended on May 7, 2019; August 9, 2022>
1. A person who has at least 10 years of teaching experience as a faculty member at a college of dentistry (including a professional graduate school of dentistry);
2. A person who is a medical professional under Article 2 (1) of the Medical Service Act and has at least 10 years of experience in medical practice.
(2) A person recommended under Article 12 (3) of the Act as the hospital director under paragraph (1) of that Article (hereinafter referred to as the "hospital director") shall submit the following documents to the board of directors, and the chairperson shall submit them to the Minister of Education: <Amended on August 9, 2022>
1. A hospital management plan and annual plans for implementing hospital management;
2. A plan to strengthen the hospital's public role and annual plans for implementing the strengthening of its public role (each plan shall include a plan for public health and medical service projects under Article 7, subparagraph 6 of the Act).

Article 9 (Concurrently Serving Faculty Members)
(1) An educational public official concurrently performing duties at a university dental hospital under Article 15 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a "concurrently serving faculty member") shall comply with the articles of incorporation of the university dental hospital and faithfully perform the duties of the hospital. <Amended on May 7, 2019>
(2) The president of a national university that has established a university dental hospital (hereinafter referred to as the "relevant university") may reduce or waive the required teaching hours for concurrently serving faculty members appointed as heads of departments, divisions, or offices under Article 4 (2), notwithstanding Article 6 of the Enforcement Decree of the Higher Education Act.
(3) Remuneration for concurrently serving faculty members shall be paid by the institutions to which they originally belong, as prescribed by the Public Officials Remuneration Regulations and the Regulations on Allowances, etc. for Public Officials.
(4) A university dental hospital may pay allowances to concurrently serving faculty members as prescribed by its articles of incorporation.
(5) Where the hospital director deems that a concurrently serving faculty member has violated paragraph (1) or falls under any subparagraph of Article 78 (1) of the State Public Officials Act, the hospital director may request the president of the relevant university to take appropriate measures, such as termination of concurrent service, following deliberation by the personnel committee prescribed by the articles of incorporation.

Article 10 (Requests for Contributions and Applications for Their Disbursement)
(1) Where the hospital director intends to receive contributions under Article 17 (1) of the Act, the hospital director shall submit a request for contributions to the Minister of Education by April 30 each year, accompanied by the following documents: <Amended 2013.3.23, 2019.5.7>
1. A business plan;
2. A projected statement of financial position and a projected income statement;
3. Documents necessary to clarify the contents of the request for contributions.
(2) When the budget for contributions is finalized, the Minister of Education shall notify the hospital director thereof. <Amended 2013.3.23>
(3) Where the hospital director intends to receive disbursement of contributions, the hospital director shall submit to the Minister of Education an application for disbursement of contributions, accompanied by quarterly business plans and budget execution plans for the relevant year. <Amended 2013.3.23>

Article 11 (Requests for Subsidies and Applications for Their Disbursement)
(1) Where the hospital director intends to receive subsidies pursuant to Article 17 (2) of the Act, the hospital director shall submit to the Minister of Education, by April 30 each year, a request for subsidies for the following year, classified into subsidies for dental education and research, subsidies for the operation of facilities and equipment, and subsidies for repayment of the principal of and interest on foreign loans, accompanied by the following documents: <Amended 2019.5.7>
1. A dental education plan and a clinical research plan (applicable only where subsidies for dental education and research are sought);
2. An operation plan for facilities and equipment (applicable only where subsidies for the operation of facilities and equipment are sought);
3. A plan for repayment of the principal of and interest on foreign loans (applicable only where subsidies for repayment of the principal of and interest on foreign loans are sought);
4. A projected income statement;
5. Other documents necessary to clearly explain the contents of the request for subsidies.
(2) Article 10 (2) and (3) shall apply mutatis mutandis to notification of the finalization of the budget for subsidies and applications for disbursement of subsidies.

Article 12 (Disposition of Surplus) Where a surplus arises from the settlement of accounts for any business year, a university dental hospital shall apply it to cover losses carried forward and carry the remainder forward to the following year. <Amended 2019.5.7>

Article 12-2 (Reports on Business Plans, etc.) Pursuant to Article 20 of the Act, the hospital director shall prepare and report business plans and budgets so as to show the expected amounts of revenue and expenditure for each project.

Article 13 (Documents to Accompany Statements of Settlement of Accounts) The term "documents prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 21 (2) 3 of the Act means a table comparing the business plan for the relevant year with the actual results of its implementation. <Amended 2019.5.7>

Article 14 (Criteria for Imposition of Administrative Fines) The criteria for imposition of administrative fines under Article 24 (1) of the Act shall be as prescribed in the Attached Table.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 20768, April 16, 2008>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on April 18, 2008.

Article 2 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on Establishment of National University Hospitals is partially amended as follows:

In Article 4 (1) 1, "college of medicine or college of dentistry" shall be replaced by "college of medicine", and the latter part of paragraph (3) of that Article shall be deleted.

In Article 5 (1), "Clinical Services Department and Dental Services Department (limited to cases where a college of dentistry has been established)" shall be replaced by "Clinical Services Department", and in the main clause of paragraph (2) of that Article, "one head for each of the Clinical Services Department and the Dental Services Department" shall be replaced by "one head for the Clinical Services Department".

(2) The Decree on the Appointment of Educational Public Officials is partially amended as follows:

In the proviso to Article 7-2 (3), "a dental hospital director under the provisions of Article 9 of the Act on Establishment of Seoul National University Dental Hospital" shall be replaced by "dental hospital directors under Article 9 of the Act on Establishment of Seoul National University Dental Hospital and Article 11 of the Act on Establishment of National University Dental Hospitals".

Article 3 (Transitional Measures following Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
The Dental Services Departments and heads of the Dental Services Departments under Article 5 (1) and (2) of the previous Enforcement Decree of the Act on Establishment of National University Hospitals existing at the time this Decree enters into force shall be deemed Dental Services Departments and heads of the Dental Services Departments of national university hospitals until the establishment of the relevant university dental hospitals under this Decree, notwithstanding the amended provisions of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Establishment of National University Hospitals as amended pursuant to Article 2 (1) of these Addenda.

ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of Education and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 24423, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso: Omitted.>

Articles 2 through 6: Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (26): Omitted.

(27) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on Establishment of National University Dental Hospitals is partially amended as follows:

In Articles 6 (2) and 8 (2), the part of Article 10 (1) preceding its subparagraphs, paragraphs (2) and (3) of that Article, and the part of Article 11 (1) preceding its subparagraphs, "Minister of Education, Science and Technology" shall each be replaced by "Minister of Education".

(28) through (105): Omitted.
